test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Shifa can do a certain piece of work in 20 days. Shifa and Afiya can together do the same work in 12 days, and Shifa, Afiya and Mariyam can do the same work together in 9 days. In how many days can Shifa and Mariyam do the same work together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(20, 12, 9) = 180 units.

Efficiency: Shifa = 9, Shifa + Afiya = 15, Shifa + Afiya + Mariyam = 20.

Efficiency of Mariyam = (S+A+M) − (S+A) = 20 − 15 = 5 units/day.

Combined Efficiency (Shifa + Mariyam) = 9 + 5 = 14 units/day.

Time = 180 ÷ 14 = 90/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 90/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Shifa (S) = 20 days, S + Afiya (A) = 12 days, S + A + Mariyam (M) = 9 days.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = LCM of individual days; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days.

⇒ Efficiency of **Shifa** = 9

⇒ Efficiency of **Afiya** = (S + A) − S = 15 − 9 = 6

⇒ Efficiency of **Mariyam** = (S + A + M) − (S + A) = 20 − 15 = 5

⇒ Combined Efficiency of **Shifa + Mariyam** = 9 + 5 = 14

⇒ Days required = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency = 180 ÷ 14

⇒ Days = 90/7

**∴ The correct answer is 90/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If two people can do work in x and y days respectively, together they do it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the efficiency of the workers if they work for the same amount of time.</p
